name: library-management-tests
description: Root for Library Management client, server, and tests

scripts.test:api: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from api-tester api-tester mongo-test && docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.test:component: docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from component-tester component-tester && docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.test:e2e: docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from e2e-runner e2e-runner frontend-e2e backend-e2e mongo-test && docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:component && npm run test:e2e
